title: Fix tracking of routing permutation in Sabre with disjoint backends
your_diff_evidence: In `qiskit/transpiler/passes/layout/sabre_layout.py::run`, the diff detects a `final_layout` shorter than `physical_qubits` and inserts untouched qubits from unused disjoint coupling components as identity mappings. This restores the contract that the routing permutation covers all physical qubits.

title: Propagate DAGCircuit.name in ApplyLayout
your_diff_evidence: In `ApplyLayout.run`, the changed line propagates the input `dag.name` onto the newly constructed output DAG instead of dropping it during layout application. The fault is loss of circuit metadata while materializing the post-layout representation, rather than a serialization/API failure.

title: Fix composing virtual permutation layouts for ElidePermutations and StarPreRouting
your_diff_evidence: In the `virtual_permutation_layout` update used by `ElidePermutations` and `StarPreRouting`, the diff removes the erroneous `current_layout.inverse(...)` from the composition and composes the layouts in the correct convention. The root cause is a mismatch between the layout representations/conventions being combined.

title: Fix deepcopy/pickle of DAGCircuit variable IO nodes
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/circuit/src/dag_circuit.rs` inside `DAGCircuit::pack_into`, the output-variable branch is corrected from `NodeType::VarIn(...)` to `NodeType::VarOut(...)`. That reconstruction path feeds deepcopy/pickle state, so the defect is in serialization/API state plumbing.

title: Fix ElidePermutations pass in the presence of PermutationGates
your_diff_evidence: In `ElidePermutations`, the diff fixes the internal `mapping` update for a `PermutationGate` to follow `M[Q[i]] <- M[Q[P[i]]]` rather than the previous incorrect indexing. This is the pass's own permutation-update algorithm; the bad `virtual_permutation_layout` is downstream fallout.

title: Fix non-determinism VF2Layout with only 1q gates
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/transpiler/src/passes/vf2/vf2_layout.rs`, the candidate sort now breaks equal-score ties with `qubit_b.cmp(qubit_a)` instead of leaving equal candidates in an unstable order. This makes 1q-only VF2 choices deterministic when scores tie.

title: Fix non-determinism in CommutativeCancellation
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/transpiler/src/passes/commutation_analysis.rs` and `commutation_cancellation.rs`, iteration-bearing `HashMap`/`HashSet` structures are replaced by ordered `IndexMap`/vector forms, and the Python wrapper passes `sorted(self.basis)`. These changes remove hash/set iteration order from cancellation sequencing.

title: Fix composition of final_layout
your_diff_evidence: In `sabre_layout.py` and the `BasicSwap`, `LookaheadSwap`, and `SabreSwap` routing passes, the diff reverses `final_layout` accumulation so the existing layout composes with the newly produced layout (for example `prev_final_layout.compose(final_layout, ...)`). The bug was composition order between successive layout representations.

title: Fix VF2 layout allocation with idle qubits
your_diff_evidence: The diff adds `vf2_utils.allocate_idle_qubits`, which fills every DAG qubit missing from the VF2 result with an unused physical qubit; both `VF2Layout.run` and `VF2PostLayout.run` call it before publishing their layouts. This repairs the layout contract for completely idle virtual qubits.

title: Fix TranspileLayout.initial_index_layout with unordered virtuals
your_diff_evidence: In `TranspileLayout.initial_index_layout` in `qiskit/transpiler/layout.py`, the diff stops treating the position from `enumerate(self.initial_layout.get_virtual_bits().items())` as the virtual-qubit index and instead uses the qubit's actual input index. Although dict order triggers the bug, the fix corrects a mapping-to-index-list representation mismatch rather than run-to-run hash nondeterminism.

title: Fix global-phase handling in CommutativeCancellation
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/transpiler/src/passes/commutation_cancellation.rs`, the merge/cancellation logic adds the missing global-phase corrections when absorbing a Pauli into a Pauli rotation and when eliminating a 2π RX/RZ rotation. The changed arithmetic is explicitly phase accumulation bookkeeping.

title: Preserve registers through Python Layout to Rust TranspileLayout conversion
your_diff_evidence: The Rust `TranspileLayout` plumbing now carries quantum-register metadata through `crates/transpiler/src/passes/apply_layout.rs` and the pass wrappers, forwarding values such as `cur_layout.input_registers().to_vec()` and `dag.qregs().to_vec()`. The PR history identifies the loss as introduced by the Python-to-Rust `ApplyLayout` move.

title: Fix DAG push-edge ordering non-determinism
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/circuit/src/dag_circuit.rs`, the diff unifies the edge-insertion logic used by `DAGCircuit::push_back`, `DAGCircuit::push_front`, and `DAGCircuitBuilder::push_back` so edges are added in a stable order. The old paths could emit different precise edge orders for multi-edge nodes.

title: Fix HighLevelSynthesis for custom gate calibrations
your_diff_evidence: In `qiskit/transpiler/passes/synthesis/high_level_synthesis.py`, the nested-instruction path changes the calibration/dirty-qubit tracker to use `global_qubits` while `context.restrict(...)` continues to receive local `qubits`. The bug was mixing the nested local-qubit coordinate system with the tracker's global-qubit representation.

title: Fix TemplateOptimization dropping the global_phase on substitution
your_diff_evidence: `qiskit/converters/circuit_to_dagdependency.py::circuit_to_dagdependency` now copies `circuit.global_phase` into the new `DAGDependency`, and `TemplateSubstitution.run_dag_opt` seeds the output phase and subtracts each matched template's phase. Those changes directly repair phase preservation and composition during substitution.

title: Fix excessive global-phase accumulation in UnrollForLoops
your_diff_evidence: In `qiskit/transpiler/passes/utils/unroll_forloops.py`, the accumulator created with `circuit_to_dag(body).copy_empty_like()` is explicitly reset to zero global phase before loop-body DAGs are composed into it. Without the reset, the body phase was present once in the empty copy and then added again for every iteration.

title: Preserve global phase in Commuting2qGateRouter
your_diff_evidence: In `commuting_2q_gate_routing/commuting_2q_gate_router.py`, temporary accumulator DAGs made with `new_dag.copy_empty_like()` now set `accumulator.global_phase = 0`, including after each routed block. This prevents the copied input phase from being composed into the output repeatedly.

title: Fix non-deterministic ConsolidateBlocks output with fixed transpiler seed
your_diff_evidence: In `qiskit/transpiler/passes/optimization/consolidate_blocks.py::ConsolidateBlocks.__init__`, the diff replaces set intersections plus `next(iter(...))` with an ordered scan such as `next(gate for gate in KAK_GATE_NAMES if gate in basis_gates)`. This removes set/hash order from KAK basis-gate selection.

title: Fix incorrect global phase shift for P and U1 gates in CommutativeCancellation
your_diff_evidence: In `crates/transpiler/src/passes/commutation_cancellation.rs`, the `-π` correction for a total 2π rotation is restricted so it applies to RX/RZ but not P/U1. The old generic adjustment incorrectly assigned P/U1 the global phase behavior of RZ.
